paraphrase: The highest good results from knowledge of the truth — produced by a particular dharma — of the categories substance, quality, motion, universal, particularity and inherence, through their similarities and dissimilarities.
notes: Present in the recension commented on by Śaṅkara Miśra (Upaskāra) but absent from Candrānanda's; scholars treat it as a later addition. Wording from memory; not checked against a local text.
